about: Catalog for the APPS workspace (Zzz5-W9). Versions, sizes and SHA-256 come from each item's own manifest, never from this file. An item without a manifest that carries sha256 is listed but never offered for download. Kind 'gated' = file only for logged-in Verso users through edge function verso-apps; version and SHA-256 come from table verso_app_releases. Field 'group' (system | module) draws the VERSO SYSTEM APP / VERSO APP MODULES sections; kind 'planned' = listed, nothing to download yet. Field 'modules' = the parts of one installable app, shown when the row is opened (one install, many modules).

apps.name: Verso app (Android)
apps.info: Verso as an Android app - ONE install with all Verso system modules inside (they work together, a single module alone would be of little use): VERSO AI, VERSO MULTIBOARD, CALCULATOR, SCROLL, MEDIA CENTER, VERSO NOTIF MULTIREADER, VOICE TRANSLATION READER.

modules.name: VERSO AI (VI)
modules.info: Verso Intelligence: the gold +AI+ ball over all apps, VI LINE, VI WINDOW and the Verso bot (in preparation). In Android › Accessibility it is called VERSO AI (optional): SCROLL, reading the visible screen only while you hold AUTO (never stored or sent), Back to the app you came from.

modules.name: VERSO MULTIBOARD
modules.info: The Verso keyboard for every app: KEYPASSBOARD (writing), PASSBOARD (password fields), chips and settings.

modules.name: CALCULATOR
modules.info: In the keyboard (123 › CALC) and in the VI panel; result or the whole calculation into the text or the clipboard.

modules.name: SCROLL
modules.info: ▲ ▼ one screen (hold = smooth), ⤒ ⤓ start / end, ◀ ▶ sideways - in any app (needs VERSO AI in Accessibility).

modules.name: MEDIA CENTER
modules.info: Media player and organizer: play / pause / next, now-playing line, copied media links, Share › VERSO MEDIA CENTER into ALL MEDIA.

modules.name: VERSO NOTIF MULTIREADER
modules.info: Reads new messages aloud, NOTIF LINE over other apps, CONTENT READER, TRANSLATOR (offline).

modules.name: VOICE TRANSLATION READER
modules.info: Translates a message into your home language and reads it aloud (e.g. Ukrainian → Slovak) - offline voice; EXTERNAL: Google offline translation models run inside the phone, the text never leaves it. Off by default.

apps.name: VERSO MULTIBOARD
apps.info: RECOMMENDED: VI MULTIBOARD - one Verso keyboard for every app; it can handle most of your daily control. One download, all modules inside (in the Verso app it is already there; without the Verso app it comes as its own small app for registered users). Soon: your own personalised keyboard under your Verso username, maybe with your own cloud / online computer.

modules.name: KEYPASSBOARD
modules.info: Writing in every app with a better key layout and options: hold a letter = its diacritics, ⇧ = symbols, text correction (Slovak diacritics added to a finished text).

modules.name: PASSBOARD
modules.info: Safe login anywhere: in password fields the keyboard turns into PASSBOARD by itself (one keyboard, not two).

modules.name: CALCULATOR
modules.info: Calculator in the keyboard (123 › CALC) and in the VI ball; result or the whole calculation into the text or the clipboard. Without CALC the 123 keys write digits.

modules.name: SCROLL
modules.info: ▲ ▼ one screen (hold = smooth), ⤒ ⤓ start / end, ◀ ▶ sideways - in any app and on the web (Verso app: Android › Accessibility › VERSO AI).

modules.name: TEXT READER
modules.info: Reads a text aloud - in the Verso app and on the web (VERSO NOTIF MULTIREADER, offline voice). Never reads codes or passwords.

modules.name: MEDIA CENTER
modules.info: Media player and organizer: play / pause / next, the now-playing line, copied media links, Share › VERSO MEDIA CENTER into ALL MEDIA.

modules.name: VI BALL
modules.info: Part of VERSO AI: a small gold ball over all apps opens the MULTIBOARD panel - SCROLL always, MEDIA and CALC on tap - also where there is no text field. Needs „Display over other apps“.

modules.name: CHATNOTES (coming)
modules.info: Verso chatnotes built in: not only a normal chat - one line is enough to contact anyone you are allowed to, safely by permission.

modules.name: VERSO AI (VI)
modules.info: VI LINE on top of the MULTIBOARD and the MINI MEDIA CENTER: a chatnote into your own VI record from any app, with priority and pack; VI ON / STANDBY / OFF for the coming Verso bot. 2× tap on VI = VI WINDOW / COMM SPACE, hold = VI SETUP. Accessibility name: VERSO AI. Needs a Verso login.

modules.name: MORE (coming)
modules.info: Screenshot, maybe QR code - mainly after Verso's own way of storing any file without opening it or backing it up separately.

apps.name: VERSO NOTIF MULTIREADER
apps.info: Verso's reading and notification modules - inside the Verso app. Never reads codes, passwords or PINs.

modules.name: NOTIFY READER
modules.info: Reads new messages aloud (Verso and the apps you switch on), offline voice, quiet regimes.

modules.name: CONTENT READER
modules.info: Reads a text on request (hold a message).

modules.name: NOTIF LINE
modules.info: One message at a time over other apps: tap = open, hold = read, left = SHIFT, right = READ.

modules.name: TRANSLATOR
modules.info: Translates a message into your home language before it is read (e.g. Ukrainian → Slovak). EXTERNAL: Google offline models run inside the phone, the text never leaves it; a language model is downloaded once. Off by default.

modules.name: SLOVAK VOICE (lili)
modules.info: Offline voice, downloaded and checked (SHA-256) inside VERSO READER.

apps.name: Verso Chat + Contacts
apps.info: Only the Verso chat with the contacts module, as its own small app (Android, iPhone, PC) - for people who do not need the whole Verso.
